title: "Alternate Russias: A Counterfactual Explorer"
robots: "noindex, nofollow"
listing: false
---

What would Russia look like today if history had gone differently? This interactive tool uses cross-national empirical modeling to explore counterfactual scenarios --- what if Medvedev had continued reforms? What if Russia hadn't annexed Crimea? What if there had been no war?

The tool combines panel data from 190+ countries with Russian household survey data to translate macro-level differences (GDP, democracy, corruption) into concrete lived experiences for five representative Russians.

### Scenarios

| Scenario | Branch Point | Key Question |
|----------|-------------|--------------|
| Medvedev Reforms | 2012 | What if Russia had continued light liberalization instead of tightening? |
| No Crimea | 2014 | What if Russia hadn't annexed Crimea and faced no sanctions? |
| No War | 2022 | What if Russia hadn't invaded Ukraine? |
| Gradual Democratization | 2008 | What if Russia had followed a Poland/South Korea path? |
| Oil Curse Deepens | 2008 | What if Russia had followed a Venezuela/Nigeria path? |
